'Tensei shitara Ken deshita II' Reveals Additional Cast Pair, Theme Songs, Second Promo
The official website of the television anime adaptation of Yuu Tanaka's Tensei shitara Ken deshita (Reincarnated as a Sword) light novel revealed an additional pair of cast, a key visual (pictured), theme songs, and the second promotional video for its second season on Sunday. The anime will premiere on October 8 at 12.00 a.m. on Tokyo MX, followed by ABC TV, BS Asahi, and AT-X. Web Manga 'Mii-chan to Yamada-san' Concludes with 7th Volume
Publisher Kodansha announced on Saturday that Nene Azuki's Mii-chan to Yamada-san (Mii-chan and Miss Yamada) web manga is ending with its seventh volume, which published its 37th and final chapter on the Magazine Pocket app. The seventh volume is scheduled for a September 9 release, marking the end of the series' two-year run. Manga 'Game Center Shoujo to Ibunka Kouryuu' Ends with 12th Volume
The official X account for author Hirokazu Yasuhara announced on Saturday that the Game Center Shoujo to Ibunka Kouryuu (Cultural Exchange With Game Center Girl) manga is ending with the 12th volume, following the publication of its 153rd and final chapter. The 12th volume is scheduled for an October 9 release, marking the end of the series' over six-year run.
